tonight.headline: McLaurin missed practice again and Monangai's rest day is turf toe; Jefferson, Likely, Addison and Kamara all practised
body: Bad news first. You are 0–4. McLaurin missed a second practice, so the 2.3 points the projection wants in your flex are not there to take. Monangai's day off turns out to be turf toe, uncertain for one to two weeks. And on the other side Ja'Marr Chase was back at practice in pads.

The rest of Thursday went your way: Jefferson and Likely were limited again, Addison and Kamara came back. As set you project 122.1 against 117.5 and ESPN gives you 52%. Tonight's game has none of your players and one of theirs, Bucky Irving. Nothing needs doing today; the three cards are all for Friday's report and Sunday morning.

case.label: Their side
case.body: Ja'Marr Chase, their top projection at 21.9, was limited on Thursday and in pads, still in the concussion protocol (bengals.com; NBC Sports, 8 Oct); on Wednesday he was 'unlikely to play'. Bucky Irving, 15.3, plays tonight with no injury listing, behind Jalon Daniels; he had 16 touches and no targets in Week 4. Chuba Hubbard is still in their flex on a bye at 0.0, so their 117.5 rises when they fix it. McBride 18.8, Purdy 18.0, London 16.0.

case.label: Your side
case.body: As set: Allen 20.1, Jefferson 18.6, Wilson 14.8, Warren 14.5, Tuten 14.0, Likely 12.9, Gordon 10.9, Fairbairn 8.5, the Vikings 7.8. Jefferson and Likely are questionable and both practised, limited, on Wednesday and Thursday.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Jefferson or Likely missing Friday's practice, on your side. Chase clearing the protocol, on theirs. McLaurin practising on Friday turns the flex back into a 2.3-point swap.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · fire it only if he practises on Friday · both kick off Sun 11:00 Mexico City · inactives 09:30
doFirst.title: Flex: leave Gordon. McLaurin only if he practises on Friday
doFirst.subtitle: 13.2 against 10.9 on paper. He missed practice again today, his second absence this week, and ESPN's number does not show either.

case.label: What the check says
case.body: As set you project 122.1; the projection lineup is 124.4. The whole 2.3 is McLaurin over Gordon in the flex, which the tool labels PROJECTION. It is the only difference.

case.label: Why it is not set
case.body: He was 'not on the field for the start of Thursday's practice' (Washington Post's Tashan Reed via NBC Sports, 8 Oct) and RotoWire has him officially out of the session; Friday is his last chance. He has not practised since the hamstring on 2 Oct. Stefon Diggs missed a second day as well. Both absences came after ESPN's 13.2 and run against it, which is the one kind of news that overrides a projection.

case.label: The order if he sits
case.body: Gordon, 10.9, keeps the slot. Kamara, 11.2, practised on Thursday (limited, back), so the two are a 0.3 coin flip. The projection would take Kamara by that margin; I am leaving it as you set it, because Kamara still carries a questionable tag and the back behind Gordon, Jaylen Wright, turned up on Miami's report with a foot. Nothing is written down for that one. All three play at 11:00 on Sunday.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: McLaurin starts in your flex and Gordon outscores him on Sunday (archive). If McLaurin does not practise or is inactive, the swap never happens and the entry closes untested.

doFirst.deadlineLabel: Fallback only · decide on Friday's report · Juwan Johnson kicks off Sun 11:00 Mexico City, with Likely
doFirst.title: If Likely is ruled out: add Juwan Johnson, free
doFirst.subtitle: Likely was limited again today and the Giants' own writer sees no danger to Sunday. You still have nobody behind him. This morning's trigger, a missed practice, did not fire. Do nothing today.

case.label: The hole
case.body: The lineup check prints it plainly: nobody eligible on the bench. The knee and groin listing is three days old and still unexplained. Against that: two limited practices, and RotoWire, citing giants.com's Dan Salomone, has 'nothing to suggest that he's in danger of missing Sunday's game'. ESPN still projects 12.9.

case.label: Who is there
case.body: Juwan Johnson, 10.1, is still a free agent: targets 4, 8, 8 in the last three weeks (archive), not on the Saints' report, and his quarterback practised in full today. He kicks off at 11:00 on Sunday, the same hour as Likely, so he can be added after the 09:30 inactive list. Dallas Goedert projects 10.9 but was limited again with a knee sprain and locks at 07:30 in London, as does Brenton Strange, 9.7. Mark Andrews, 9.6, had his quarterback miss a second practice.

case.label: The drop
case.body: Addison, if Jefferson is active: he is 7.2 under Jefferson and off in Week 6. If Jefferson's own status is in doubt, Addison is needed, and the seat is Monangai's if Friday rules him out with the turf toe, or Coker's if it does not. Kamara and Gordon each have an injured teammate and cannot be named.

case.label: Why not add him today
case.body: He is free, so a rival can take him at any moment. Against that, the strategy says not to carry a second tight end in a league whose flex cannot use one, and Likely has now practised twice. The case for waiting is stronger than it was this morning. It is still a risk I am choosing.

case.label: Falsified if
case.body: Likely is ruled out and Johnson, Goedert, Strange and Andrews are all gone by then (the wait cost the slot). Or, if it fires, the tight end added scores less than the player dropped for him would have (archive). If Likely plays, this card never fires.

whatWentWrong.title: Monangai's 'rest day' is turf toe
whatWentWrong.lead: Jeremy Fowler reports his status is uncertain for one to two weeks. He has not practised since the 30-carry game.

Fowler, via CBS/RotoWire at 17:23 ET and NBC Sports: turf toe, uncertain for the next one to two weeks, 'aiming to play through it'. On Wednesday his coach had put it down to 30 carries. D'Andre Swift returned to practice, limited.

case.body: He was already on your bench by projection, so no lineup move. It changes the third card's drop: if he is ruled out on Friday, his is the seat a tight end would take, ahead of Coker's. And the open hold on him is now closer to breaking than holding.

case.body: A practice on Friday and an active tag on Sunday, with Swift's hip still limiting him.

worthALook.name: Juwan Johnson
worthALook.lead: Still a free agent: the fallback tight end, because he kicks off with Likely. His quarterback practised in full today.

case.label: The role
case.body: Targets 4, 8, 8 in the last three weeks for 10.6, 23.3 and 11.9 (archive). Not on the Saints' Thursday report; Tyler Shough went from limited to full with the left hand.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 10.1 against Likely's 12.9, with nowhere to play a second tight end. Minnesota's defence is ranked second for the week by NBC Sports.

case.label: When to act
case.body: Friday afternoon if Likely is ruled out or does not practise; otherwise Sunday 09:30, and only if Likely is inactive. If a rival adds him first, Goedert, Strange and Andrews remain, each with an earlier lock or a quarterback problem.

worthALook.sources: Week 2–4 archive · neworleanssaints.com · NBC Sports · ESPN league file

worthALook.name: Brenton Strange
worthALook.lead: A real role, and no use to you unless Likely sits. He locks at 07:30 on Sunday, before Likely's inactive list.

case.label: The role
case.body: 7 catches on 8 targets for 95 in Week 4 (archive) with every Jacksonville pass-catcher playing, so no injury explains it. Targets 3, 2, 5, 8. He is not on Jacksonville's Thursday report.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: One tight-end slot, an RB/WR-only flex, and Likely projects 3.2 higher. Philadelphia allow the fifth-fewest points to tight ends (FootballDB, PPR, re-read today).

case.label: When to act
case.body: Only if Likely is ruled out by Saturday. If the decision goes to Sunday's inactive list, Strange has already kicked off and Juwan Johnson is the one.

worthALook.name: Rico Dowdle
worthALook.lead: The back who takes carries from your Warren when he returns. Limited again, and his coach calls it up in the air.

case.label: The role
case.body: Limited on Wednesday and Thursday with the toe (Steelers Depot, 8 Oct). McCarthy: status still up in the air, and a platoon once he is healthy (RotoWire, a paraphrase). With him active Warren took 56% and 55% of the carries; without him, all of them (archive).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: A handcuff to a back you start, on a roster with five backs and no free seat. He ran 15 times for 37 yards before the injury (archive).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing makes him an add here. A full practice on Friday matters for Warren's number, not for your roster.

worthALook.sources: Steelers Depot · RotoWire · SI · Week 1–4 archive

doNotChase.name: Will Shipley
doNotChase.lead: Still one of the wire's biggest risers. Barkley missed practice again; nobody on the Eagles' staff has said how the work splits.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Saquon Barkley did not practise on Thursday and has done no on-field work since the hamstring (Bleeding Green Nation; CBS, 8 Oct 16:59 ET); Tank Bigsby is on injured reserve. CBS calls Shipley 'poised for a workhorse role' and Inside the Iggles expects him to start.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Those are outlets' reads; no coach has described a split, and Dameon Pierce is on the 53. 6 carries for 23 last week and 15 all season (archive). 10.2 is below all five of your backs.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Barkley ruled out for a month, and one of your own backs ruled out with him.

doNotChase.sources: Bleeding Green Nation · CBS Sports · Inside the Iggles · Week 1–4 archive

doNotChase.name: Jaguars D/ST
doNotChase.lead: The fastest-rising free defence, 0.2 above yours.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Philadelphia in London without Barkley and DeVonta Smith at practice all week, without Hollywood Brown, and with Dontayvion Wicks hurting a hamstring during Thursday's session. NBC Sports ranks Jacksonville first for the week.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 8.0 against the Vikings' 7.8. Under a point is not a streaming move. Four Jacksonville corners were limited again on Thursday, and they are off in Week 7.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Nothing this week. Next Tuesday you need a defence for Minnesota's bye, and that is when this row is read again.

doNotChase.sources: ESPN league file · Bleeding Green Nation · Jaguars Wire · NBC Sports

doNotChase.name: Roman Wilson
doNotChase.lead: New today: rising because Pittman is out for weeks. His targets did not move the last time that happened.

case.label: The rise
case.body: Michael Pittman Jr. re-injured his foot and will miss 'multiple weeks' (McCarthy via Steelers Depot, 8 Oct). When Pittman sat in Week 2, Wilson was the second receiver beside DK Metcalf on 55 of 70 snaps (The Fantasy Footballers).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Six targets in every one of his four games, the Week 2 game without Pittman included (archive). He shared those second-receiver snaps with the rookie Germie Bernard. 10.3, below McLaurin and Addison on your bench.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets against Indianapolis. He is a free agent, so it costs nothing to look again on Tuesday.

doNotChase.sources: Steelers Depot · The Fantasy Footballers · Week 1–4 archive

doNotChase.name: Malik Washington
doNotChase.lead: Carried from this morning, nothing new: target share in an offence that barely throws.

case.label: The rise
case.body: 5 catches on 5 targets for 67, 12.0 (archive). He is not on Miami's Thursday report.

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: Targets 8, 5, 10, 5 (archive). Miami are off in Week 6, the same week as your Vikings.

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets against Cincinnati, or a different quarterback in Miami.

doNotChase.name: Makai Lemon
doNotChase.lead: Three Eagles receivers are now hurt, which is a real reason. He has not passed six points in a game.

case.label: The rise
case.body: DeVonta Smith and Hollywood Brown did not practise on Thursday and Dontayvion Wicks hurt a hamstring in the session. If all three sit, the receivers are Darius Cooper, Lemon, Britain Covey and Elijah Moore (Bleeding Green Nation, 8 Oct).

case.label: The number that kills it
case.body: 3 catches on 6 targets for 27, 5.7, with Smith already out; 2.5, 1.9 and 5.9 before that (archive).

case.label: What would change it
case.body: Eight or more targets in London.

doNotChase.sources: Week 1–4 archive · Bleeding Green Nation via Yahoo

waiverAnalysis.summary: The same four receivers clear the tool's bar as this morning, and the bar is still partly an artefact: it measures them against Coker, whose last two weeks are an injury and a missed game. Four weeks of data. Today's reports sharpened three of the role reasons and turned none into a move. Nothing clears at running back or tight end.

rising.name: Romeo Doubs
rising.roleReason: 9 targets in Week 4 after Mack Hollins left. Hollins (calf) missed practice again on Thursday; Mike Vrabel had said 'I wouldn't anticipate Mack being out there' (98.5 The Sports Hub, 8 Oct). A.J. Brown is eligible to practise next week (Doug Kyed via Heavy, 8 Oct).
rising.action: WATCH — the role probably lasts one more game, with the team's best receiver due back at practice next week
rising.sources: 98.5 The Sports Hub · Heavy · Week 1–4 archive

rising.name: Dohnte Meyers
rising.roleReason: 7 catches on 9 targets after Ja'Marr Chase and Tee Higgins left in Week 4. Chase was limited and in pads on Thursday, still in the protocol (NBC Sports, 8 Oct); Higgins missed a second practice (bengals.com). Cincinnati are off in Week 6.
rising.action: WATCH — the role shrinks the day Chase is cleared, and he is moving that way; no receiver seat is open

rising.name: Khalil Shakir
rising.roleReason: 7 catches on 8 targets for 82 in the game DJ Moore left with an aggravated AC joint. Moore did not practise on Thursday, Buffalo's first session, and his Monday status is undetermined (Heavy; Bills On SI, 8 Oct).
rising.action: WATCH — depends on Moore missing Monday night, which is two more practices away
rising.sources: Heavy · Bills On SI · Week 4 archive

rising.name: KC Concepcion
rising.roleReason: The steadiest of the four: targets 5, 6, 9, 8 (archive). He is not on Cleveland's Thursday report. The volume is real and the production is 7.6 a game.
rising.action: WATCH — a real role at 7.6 points a game, and no receiver seat is open

settled.title: Kamara in the flex once McLaurin and Coker were out (the contingency, 2–4 Oct)
settled.result: Archive: Kamara 22.8, but Monangai, still unlocked when the swap was made, scored 28.0. Closed WRONG by 5.2, as its own falsifier said.

settled.title: 'Start Kamara in the flex; bench Coker' (Sunday morning's brief)
settled.result: Coker was inactive and scored 0; Kamara scored 22.8 (archive). Closed RIGHT.

settled.title: If Jefferson is inactive, add Addison and start him (30 Sep)
settled.result: It fired. Archive: Addison 9.1, Kamara 22.8. The falsifier named Kamara, so it closes WRONG. Boston, the player you dropped for him, scored 12.9.

settled.title: Dropping Kyle Pitts on usage (22 Sep)
settled.result: Archive: Likely beat him 3.3 to 1.5 and 13.6 to 7.7, so the two-of-three clause can't fire. His snap share was 59% in Week 3 and I could not get a figure for Monday; PFF says 'typical 2026 levels'. Closed RIGHT on the scores.

settled.title: Tuten in the RB slot over the bench backs (the projection lineup)
settled.result: Archive: Tuten 11.1, Monangai 28.0, Gordon 18.0. No brief overrode the projection; the projection lost.

settled.title: 'Fairbairn is 0.5 better; under a point isn't a move' (Sunday morning's brief)
settled.result: You made the swap. Archive: Fairbairn 16, Pineiro 5. The hold closed WRONG by 11.

settled.title: 'Monangai is not the drop until the thumb is known' (4–5 Oct)
settled.result: Held through Wednesday. On Thursday the 'rest day' turned out to be turf toe (Fowler); the hold is leaning broken and is read after Week 5.

settled.title: 'The claim turns on whether Jefferson is ruled out on Tuesday' (Monday's brief)
settled.result: He wasn't, and nothing was published either way. No claim was made.

settled.title: Claim Gordon for Achane: 'under 12 touches in Week 4 means a timeshare' (28 Sep)
settled.result: He had 11 touches, so it closed WRONG as written, and scored 18.0. The clause was badly written; the claim gained.
